resources.string:
Mages shares your location only when you choose to.

Live location: your precise location is sent to this room and visible to its members. It continues in the background with a notification until the timer ends or you tap Stop Sharing.

One-time location: your current location is sent once as a message.

Your location is sent to your Matrix homeserver and not used elsewhere. You can stop sharing or turn off permission in Settings at any time.
Location permission is required for live location sharing
